args.sql:
SELECT
  p.babylon_guid,
  p.status,
  p.provisioned_at,
  p.retired_at,
  p.retirement_date,
  p.modified_at,
  p.ordered_by,
  u.email AS user_email
FROM provisions p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.babylon_guid IN ('b2fqz','d6vjs','h2wzd','k9rbf','m5yhb','p4xnl','r8cyh','t7mqc','w3gkt')
ORDER BY p.babylon_guid

SELECT
  p.babylon_guid,
  p.status,
  p.provisioned_at,
  p.retirement_date,
  p.retired_at,
  u.email AS user_email
FROM provisions p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.account_id = u.id
WHERE p.babylon_guid IN ('b2fqz','d6vjs','h2wzd','k9rbf','m5yhb','p4xnl','r8cyh','t7mqc','w3gkt')
ORDER BY p.provisioned_at DESC
